purpose: Scene-enriching original static prop for an imaginative world aimed at young children; artistic colors/textures/pose/proportions are welcome.

subject.pose: Static slight body curve; fins separated, no water sheet or stand.

claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired art with basic recognizable anatomy. Not strict scientific reconstruction; no exact locomotion, life-history, coexistence or animation-readiness claim.
distinctness: Sturdy oval scaled silhouette is the key new geometry; no exact scale count is claimed.
coverage_justification: Six meaningful fixed-framing views are the complete default environment-prop plan; add a targeted angle only for a real concern, never a production turntable campaign.

scale.kind: art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension

style: Match the accepted small-life pilot family with calm original surfaces and readable shape. Suggested colors are creative, not fossil facts. Avoid threatening feeding scenes, extra decorative props or an unrelated new rendering style.
artistic_choices: Suggested palette: muted bronze and gray-blue, soft scale rhythm
Nominal size, proportions, pose, missing fine parts and simplified detail are artistic.
Tiny subjects need close placement or an explicit creative display-scale choice; do not promise readability from a distant island camera.
Opaque or economical portable materials are preferred. Fine translucent/vein/feather detail is optional when it does not survive normal viewing.
review_bound: One consolidated independent basic-form/aesthetic review, at most one planned cosmetic repair; record minor tradeoffs and continue without individual user approval. Real technical/identity blockers receive targeted repair.

criteria.description: Exact standalone GLB validates and reimports; no missing dependencies, nonfinite geometry or broken units/origin; budgets measured and warnings dispositioned.

Readable distinct core form in the six normal-scale views; no conspicuous unintended penetration, detached major parts or clearly broken shading. Minor color/facet differences and artistic choices are advisory.
Stylized-inspired basic-form obligation: Deep oval, laterally compressed fish body with a clear head and narrower tail attachment.
Stylized-inspired basic-form obligation: Use a few orderly broad hard-scale rows to suggest the armored surface; scales must follow the body rather than random spikes.
Stylized-inspired basic-form obligation: Keep a compact mouth, readable fins and tail; contrast the sturdy oval form with the slimmer Diplomystus and rounder Pycnodus.

Editable source, deterministic generator/config, standalone GLB, original maps if used, exact hashes, six QA views and one hero poster. Label stylized-inspired and static; include actual source/generator/config hashes in the final versioned execution brief.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader; record bounds, material/texture metrics and errors.
Inspect this exact GLB in a declared graphics runtime. Record renderer/device; a SwiftShader PASS is functional software-render evidence, not physical GPU/device performance.
Inspect a neutral simple prop benchmark with the exact GLB and recorded visible copy count/work. Do not require current-museum integration or scientific coexistence for this asset brief.

research_boundary: The archived research gate is preserved. This creative production scope does not certify that every fossil question has been resolved.
